messages:
Dana: Heads-up — eviction spike in ap-southeast1c for tiny pods (tiny-*) since ~07:40. Cost blip and paging noise. Anyone seen this pattern? :eyes:
sched-bot: ALERT: evictions[gpu-ap-southeast1c] = 5.4/min (10m avg).
Mikko: Any recent label/taint rollouts?
Dana: We enforced gpu.family=rtxA on the pool yesterday. Quick node sample: Labels: gpu.family=rtxA / Taints: nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule. Older rtx7 nodes still exist.
Priya: Scheduler bind errors show nodeAffinity mismatch: "Fit failed: node(s) didn't match node affinity (gpu.family in [rtx7])". Small pods are squashed onto rtx7 nodes and get evicted when larger jobs start.
Ken: Short fixes: 1) bump warmpool in that AZ, 2) flip a few rtxA nodes' taint to PreferNoSchedule as a hotfix, 3) deploy a mutating webhook to convert required->preferred nodeAffinity for pods requesting <=1 GPU.
Mikko: I'll scale warmpool 6->14 now. Dana, can you run a jq audit to list pods with required gpu.family affinity?
Dana: Ran it: ~96 pods cluster-wide with required gpu.family, 54 in ap-southeast1c. Opening TICKET-6210: "ap-southeast1c tiny-pod eviction wave — affinity/taint fragmentation" and assigning infra/runtime.
Priya: Canarying webhook in ml namespace at 10%. Also temporarily increased binpack imbalance_tolerance to 0.18 for the AZ. Monitor NVLink/thermal.
sched-bot: METRIC: evictions.ap-southeast1c dropped to 0.9/min after actions.
Ken: Long-term: inventory remaining rtx7-bound workloads, add CI gate to prevent required gpu.family on new images, and evaluate a packing-aware scheduler plugin that understands fractional/co-located pods.
Dana: Thanks — will follow up in TICKET-6210. :thumbsup:
